title: Level-60 Production Readiness Audit
subtitle: Tiered launch: the game ships in tiers — Launch 1 = CloverVillage (levels 1–20), Launch 2 = HappyValley (21–40), Launch 3 = VoidDesert (41–60). We are focusing ONLY on Launch 1 (CloverVillage). HappyValley and VoidDesert are cataloged but out of scope until their launch tier.

launchPlan.label: FIRST LAUNCH — ACTIVE FOCUS
launchPlan.scope: Everything needed to ship levels 1–20. Environment is strong; the blockers are enemies, a boss, dungeon interactables, item/consumable icons, quest content, and UI/audio for this zone only.

launchPlan.label: LAUNCH 2 — OUT OF SCOPE
launchPlan.scope: Cataloged (map kit, NPCs, monsters). Revisit at that tier: add 2–3 hostile identities + a boss, plus shared systems still missing globally.

launchPlan.label: LAUNCH 3 — OUT OF SCOPE
launchPlan.scope: Cataloged (nature, map kit, full monster roster). Revisit at that tier: add NPC/service identities. Its monster pack already covers the tier's progression.

overall.label: LAUNCH 1 (CLOVERVILLAGE 1–20) · CONTENT IN PROGRESS
overall.note: All 16 file categories across 7 packs are audited and classified. For the FIRST LAUNCH specifically: CloverVillage environment, NPCs, and the three playable classes are production-ready. The launch blockers are concentrated: a native enemy roster, a regional boss, dungeon interactables, item/consumable icons, quest content, and zone UI/audio. HappyValley and VoidDesert work is deferred to their launch tiers.

worldTiers.label: ENVIRONMENT STRONG · PvE CONTENT MISSING

systems.coverage: buildings 18 families · ground 4 · roads 5 · decor 8 · source
Artist · Astrologer · Citizen (3 identities, 5 animation states)
none — no native enemy roster in the catalog
systems.missing: 4–6 normal enemies (slime/animal/insect-plant/bandit-goblin + stronger regional), 2 elite variants, 1 regional boss

worldTiers.note: The #1 missing content package in the catalog. Level 1–20 has world and NPC material but no enemies.

worldTiers.label: ENVIRONMENT STRONG · PARTIAL PvE

systems.coverage: Blacksmith · Jeweler · Sage (3 identities, 7 expressive states) — equipment/crafting/enchantment anchors
5 wildlife identities (black_grouse, boar, deer, fox, hare) — boar is the only one with attack
systems.missing: 2–3 hostile identities (humanoid outlaw, corrupted creature, large brute) + 1 regional/dungeon boss. Wildlife alone gets repetitive across 20 levels.

worldTiers.note: Surprisingly close on environment. Needs only 2–3 hostile additions, not another large pack.

worldTiers.label: STRONGEST COMBAT ZONE

systems.coverage: 7 identities: robber, thug, goblin variants, assassin, chief goblin → natural 41–60 progression; Warlord boss candidate
Warlord (700×700 expressive boss package) is an obvious candidate
no civilian quest hub — Warlord dialogue is not NPC service coverage
systems.missing: 3 functional NPC identities (merchant, quest/lore, service/crafting) — may reuse existing rigs

worldTiers.note: No giant monster package needed. The gap is NPC/service coverage.

dungeons.label: NO SEPARATE TILESETS NEEDED
dungeons.note: Dungeons remix each world's own environment under darker lighting + concentrated spawns. Same visual family, different layout.
dungeons.missing: Shared dungeon-interaction mini-pack: door/gate (closed/open/locked), lever (off/on), pressure plate (up/pressed), portal/entrance marker, key-object visual. Chest already exists in HappyValley. Later: spikes, floor fire, poison pool, collapsing floor, breakable pots/crates.

playerClasses.label: 3 CLASSES ENOUGH · ABILITY KITS NEED MAPPING
playerClasses.note: Warrior (264 assets), Mage (173), Archer (127) cover a level-60 initial release. Do not add classes. Complete each class's ability vocabulary to level 60 instead — roughly 5–6 active abilities + basic attack (7 combat actions) per class, largely reusing existing effects: Mage already has fire/water ball + spell; Warrior has 10 numbered slash variants; Archer's normal/default arrow projectile is a notable gap.
playerClasses.missing: Per-class skill mapping: level-1 basic attack, level-5/10/20/30/45 skills, level-60 ultimate. Archer default arrow projectile asset.

sharedSystems.coverage: no item category in the catalog
sharedSystems.missing: Inventory icons only (no paper-doll art): 6 gear tiers × (weapon/armor/accessory) × 3 classes via icon reuse + rarity treatment
Health / mana / revive / food — one icon per type, potency via data (Minor/Greater/Superior)

sharedSystems.coverage: none — despite Blacksmith + Jeweler NPCs implying crafting
sharedSystems.missing: Ore / wood / leather / cloth / gem / herb / monster material, tiered by world (Clover/Valley/Void)
Content database: 5–7 main quests + 10–15 side quests + world activities (kill/gather/deliver/escort/interact/explore/elite hunt) + dungeon quests per zone. XP tuning carries each 20-level band.
System, largely CSS/UI components: health, class resource, ability bar, XP, level, enemy health/name, boss bar, quest tracker, inventory, equipment, loot popup, dialogue, shop, death/respawn, minimap
Audit needed — no audio assets are indexed

One memorable boss for the level 1–20 tier (Happy boss and Warlord belong to their own tiers).
door/gate, lever, pressure plate, portal/entrance, key object; reuse the existing chest — needed for any Clover dungeon content.

5–7 main quests + side quests + world activities + a dungeon, tuned so data carries the player 1→20.
HUD/system for the first zone and its music/SFX — minimal, launch-scoped.
~3 NPC identities — deferred to Launch 3, not needed for the first launch.
2–3 hostiles + a regional boss — deferred to Launch 2.
